name: KY-006 passive buzzer module
description: Passive piezo buzzer module: a buzzer with NO built-in oscillator, so it only sounds while the microcontroller feeds it a square wave (PWM). The pitch follows the PWM frequency; it is loudest around 2 kHz and usable over roughly 1.5-2.5 kHz (plays other notes more quietly). A steady high or low level is silent (just a click). The signal pin powers the buzzer directly. Sold as: common KY-006 passive buzzer module (Keyes / HW-508 clone, e.g. Electrokit 41015714), 3-pin header S, (middle, not used), -.
eli5: A tiny speaker: wiggle the pin on and off quickly with PWM and it plays a note; change how fast you wiggle it to change the note.

pins.name: S
pins.description: Signal: a PWM square wave (about 50 % duty) plays a tone at the PWM frequency; duty 0 or a steady level = silent. This pin also supplies the buzzer's current.

pins.name: NC
pins.description: Middle pin, not used on this module (leave unconnected)

buildNotes: Wire S to a PWM-capable GPIO and - to GND; leave the middle pin unconnected. There is no separate supply pin: the GPIO drives the buzzer.
Passive buzzer: it needs a tone. Use machine.PWM with duty_u16(32768) (50 %) and set freq() to the note; duty_u16(0) silences it. Pin.value(1) alone only gives a click.
Loudest near 2 kHz (its resonance); notes far below about 1 kHz are quiet.
A GPIO can drive it directly at 3.3 V. For more volume or a 5 V drive, switch it with an NPN transistor (e.g. 2N2222, 1 kOhm base resistor) from the 5 V rail.
Some clone boards label the pins differently or mark the middle pin +; read the silkscreen before wiring.

example.code:
from machine import Pin, PWM
import time

buzzer = PWM(Pin({S}))  # passive buzzer: needs a square wave
buzzer.duty_u16(0)
while True:
    buzzer.freq(2000)        # 2 kHz, near the buzzer's loudest point
    buzzer.duty_u16(32768)   # 50 % duty square wave = tone
    print('TONE 2000 Hz')
    time.sleep(1)
    buzzer.duty_u16(0)       # no wave = silent
    print('QUIET')
    time.sleep(2)

test.title: The buzzer plays a tone, then goes quiet
